name: dsh-command-context
description: A /context slash command for DeepSeek Harness: shows how much of the current session's context window is used, how much is free, and a per-category breakdown of what fills it.
author: Lovenndme

compatibility.note: Host half uses ctx.commands.register, ctx.sessions.get, ctx.tokenMeter.measure and Session.requestContext/requestHeader/eventAt; on a host without those services the plugin fails to load instead of printing wrong numbers. Client half occupies the keyed slot conversation.chat.commandview under key 'context' so the report renders expanded; without that slot the generic collapsed card is used.
